name: GPU A-Buffer Construction for Ray-Primitive Intersection
aliases: Dynamic Data Structure for Ray Processing
Dynamic Linked List for Primitive Supports
GPU A-Buffer Construction for Ray-Primitive Intersection — Dynamic Data Structure for Ray Processing, Sphere-Cone A-Buffer
definition: A two-step GPU implementation for efficient ray processing: 1) Build a dynamic data structure (A-buffer) storing entry/exit points of ray-primitive support intersections. 2) Process rays using this structure to retrieve overlapping primitives. This avoids processing empty areas and limits compulsory field evaluations.
summary: GPU A-Buffer Construction for Ray-Primitive Intersection is a dynamic acceleration structure that efficiently identifies overlapping primitives using geometry and fragment shaders, avoiding empty space evaluation and explicit cutoffs via compact support kernels.
